verdict: Organic traffic is steady, but Google Business activity has dropped sharply.
narrative: This period, your website held its footing — GA4 sessions ran flat at roughly 268 per day over the last three days, consistent with the prior stretch, and 7,351 sessions came in across the full 28-day window with no paid advertising running. Your Google Business Profile, however, saw a steep drop: the last three days averaged just 3 actions per day against a prior average of 23, including two consecutive days of zero activity on August 26–27. No paid spend ran on Meta or Google this period, so all traffic and engagement is organic. Purchase and revenue tracking is currently showing $0, which reflects a pixel configuration issue rather than zero actual sales — that tracking is being corrected. Several deliverables are due August 31st, including the Meta funnel test close, UTM implementation, and SEO Phase 1 guardrails, which will set the foundation for paid activity launching in the weeks ahead.
